brief:
Settlers intensified assaults against Palestinians and their property in scattered locations throughout the occupied West Bank, the Shehab Wire reported. The wave of attacks encompassed stone-throwing at vehicles, deliberate destruction of belongings, and direct assaults on agricultural land and livestock belonging to Palestinian farmers.

The escalation extends settler violence beyond confrontations on roadways into rural farming zones where Palestinians cultivate crops and raise animals as primary sources of income. Farmers face mounting threats to their ability to access and work their land safely.
